payload.evidence_against: Direct GR alignment, HMM/DTW paths, global sequence profiles, analog registration, and global action coordinates have all failed legal transfer. Repeated motifs and partial GR coverage may leave candidate likelihood underidentified.
payload.evidence_for: T033 pair-32 candidate actions preserve 4.628457 RMSE oracle capacity in 1,520 unique actions. E010 and T023 evaluate well-level or base-path evidence, not features recomputed under each proposed candidate TVT path. Hidden horizontal GR is test-available and candidate TVT changes the typewell reference trace.
payload.next_test: Execute frozen T036 only. Require path-conditioned advantage over action priors and failure of reversed/shifted/shuffled evidence controls.
payload.statement: Candidate-specific hidden-GR/typewell evidence can rank a compact sub-5 action dictionary even though global action coordinates are not legally identifiable.
payload.title: Path-conditioned GR evidence identifies high-capacity candidate actions
